title.zh: OKX 完成 250 亿美元估值融资，Circle、Ripple 与 SC Ventures 参投
title.en: OKX Raises Fresh Funding at $25 Billion Valuation; Circle, Ripple and SC Ventures Join

current_state.zh: OKX宣布获得Circle、Ripple、QRT以及渣打银行旗下SC Ventures的战略投资，投前估值为250亿美元，使该交易所与主要稳定币、支付和银行机构并肩。
current_state.en: OKX announced a strategic investment from Circle, Ripple, QRT and Standard Chartered's SC Ventures at a $25 billion pre-money valuation, positioning the exchange alongside major stablecoin, payments and banking institutions.

updates.title_zh: 【OKX 以 250 亿美元估值完成新一轮融资，渣打等参投】
updates.title_en: 【OKX 以 250 亿美元估值完成新一轮融资，渣打等参投】
updates.what_changed_zh: OKX 本轮融资为 3 月融资的延伸轮，参投方还包括量化对冲基金 Qube Research & Technologies。
updates.what_changed_en: OKX's new round is an extension of its March funding round, and the investor list also includes quant hedge fund Qube Research & Technologies.
updates.current_state_zh: OKX 以 250 亿美元估值完成新一轮融资，该轮为 3 月融资的延伸轮，参投方包括 Circle、Ripple、渣打银行旗下 SC Ventures 及 Qube Research & Technologies。
updates.current_state_en: OKX has completed a new funding round at a $25 billion valuation, an extension of its March round, with Circle, Ripple, Standard Chartered's SC Ventures, and Qube Research & Technologies participating.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OKX完成新一轮融资，估值达250亿美元，为3月融资的延伸轮，参投方包括Circle、Ripple、渣打银行旗下SC Ventures及量化对冲基金Qube Research & Technologies。
updates.detailed_summary_en: OKX完成新一轮融资，估值达250亿美元，为3月融资的延伸轮，参投方包括Circle、Ripple、渣打银行旗下SC Ventures及量化对冲基金Qube Research & Technologies。
updates.background_zh: SC Ventures 是渣打银行旗下的创新与创投部门，此前曾投资 Zodia Custody 等加密相关业务。Qube Research & Technologies 是一家全球量化与系统化投资管理机构，覆盖各类流动性资产。该消息最初来自彭博社，由 Foresight News 转述。
updates.background_en: SC Ventures is Standard Chartered's innovation and venture unit, which has previously invested in crypto-related businesses including Zodia Custody. Qube Research & Technologies is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager that operates across liquid asset classes. The report originates from Bloomberg, with Foresight News relaying it.
updates.market_impact_zh: 本轮融资涉及的是交易所股权而非代币，直接影响渠道主要在于市场情绪与机构关系；Circle 和 Ripple 的参与将 OKX 的股东结构与平台上 USDC、XRP 相关流动性联系起来，而 SC Ventures 的参投则指向托管与受监管基础设施方面的关联。
updates.market_impact_en: The raise concerns exchange equity rather than tokens, so its direct market channel is sentiment and institutional relationship-building; the presence of Circle and Ripple ties OKX's ownership base to USDC and XRP-related liquidity on the venue, while SC Ventures' participation points to custody and regulated-infrastructure links.

updates.detailed_summary_en: OKX announced a strategic investment from Circle, Ripple, QRT and Standard Chartered's SC Ventures at a $25 billion pre-money valuation, positioning the exchange alongside major stablecoin, payments and banking institutions.
updates.background_zh: OKX 于 2013 年以 Okcoin 之名成立，2017 年更名为 OKX，是日交易量最大的加密货币交易所之一，业务遍及多个司法辖区。SC Ventures 是渣打银行用于投资金融科技及替代业务模式的平台，其中包括数字资产产品。投前估值是风险投资领域的标准术语，指新增投资进入前公司所约定的价值。
updates.background_en: OKX was founded in 2013 as Okcoin, rebranded to OKX in 2017, and operates one of the largest crypto exchanges by daily trading volume, with operations across multiple jurisdictions. SC Ventures is Standard Chartered's platform for investing in fintech and alternative business models, including digital asset products. Pre-money valuation is a standard venture-capital term for a company's agreed value immediately before a new investment is added.
updates.market_impact_zh: OKX 是按日交易量计最大的交易场所之一，而包括 USDC 发行方 Circle 与渣打银行创投部门在内的投资方，将该交易所与稳定币发行以及银行关联的托管和支付渠道连接起来。因此该交易影响的是头部交易所之间的竞争格局与机构进入渠道，而非代币供应或交易规则。
updates.market_impact_en: OKX is one of the largest venues by daily trading volume, and backers including Circle (issuer of USDC) and Standard Chartered's venture arm connect the exchange to stablecoin issuance and bank-linked custody and payments channels. The deal therefore bears on competitive positioning among top-tier exchanges and on institutional access routes, rather than on token supply or trading rules.
